## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the checks performed and their results. Explain any checks that could not run.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe relevant compatibility and permission changes using non-sensitive
information, or write "None". Keep internal operational details out of public PRs.

- [ ] Documentation reflects the resulting behavior.
- [ ] Dependencies and workflow changes have been reviewed, when applicable.
- [ ] The content is appropriate for the repository's audience; no credentials,
      sensitive personal data, or unrelated WIP files are included.
